findings.problem: The data-agreed email must say when the proposal will come (voice.md, 'How we win a client' step 3, and the preview on line 2 promises it). Line 16 only says 'We'll tell you when to expect it', so the owner never gets a timeframe.
findings.fix: Give a timeframe or the event that triggers it, for example: 'We'll send your proposal within about two weeks of getting your files.'
